sub_service: Garbage/sanitation complaint via Srinagar Municipal Corporation's JK SAMADHAN grievance portal
description: smcsrinagar.jk.gov.in's own live homepage was fetched directly, twice (once for general navigation, once specifically re-checking the exact wording of the Grievance Redressal description before trusting it). Both fetches agree, verbatim: 'Register and track grievances related to civic services, sanitation, water supply, roads, street lighting, and other municipal issues,' followed by a 'Lodge Grievance' link to the state's unified grievance system, JK SAMADHAN (samadhan.jk.gov.in/login, login-gated so category-level detail beyond this description could not be confirmed further). SMC's own separate 'Sanitation Services' menu item (/Home/Subcards) independently confirms this is an actively administered municipal service, not just aspirational portal copy. No numeric SLA found.
procedure: Register a grievance via JK SAMADHAN (samadhan.jk.gov.in, login required), or contact SMC directly (phone +91-194-2474499 / 0194-2470465, email commissioner-smc@jk.gov.in).
sla: SLA NOT FOUND for waste & sanitation complaints specifically -- no numeric response/resolution time is published on any reachable SMC page.
escalation_procedure: NOT FOUND IN OFFICIAL SOURCE on this page.
